title: fluid-design config
description: Config for the fluid-design generator. Each unit is a CSS length equal to exactly 1px at `reference`, so a Figma number is written as that number times the unit (`calc(64 * var(--fluid-display))`). See references/fluid-scale.md for the full model.

$schema.description: Standard JSON Schema self-reference. Not read by the generator.

prefix.description: Utility, class and (SCSS) function/mixin name prefix — renames `fluid-*` utilities (Tailwind), the `.fluid-frame` class (vanilla CSS) and the `fluid()`/`fluid-display()`/`fluid-frame`/etc. Sass identifiers. It does NOT rename the `--fluid*` custom-property names the generator emits (`--fluid`, `--fluid-display`, `--fluid-copy`, `--fluid-chrome`, `--header-h`, ...) — those are fixed across every stack and every prefix; see references/attribute-contract.md §1.

reference.description: The viewport where every unit equals exactly 1px. This is a CONTENT budget, not the design canvas — it is deliberately narrower than `canvas.width` so the composition fits a typical desktop window rather than the full Figma frame. See fluid-scale.md "the reference is 1440x900, and the Figma canvas is 1680 wide".

width.description: Reference width in CSS px. Divides the width arm: `100vw / width`. Must be > 0.

height.description: Reference height in CSS px. Divides the height arm: `100svh / height`. Must be > 0. Ignored when `heightAxis` is false.

canvas.description: The drawn design-file frame. Independent of `reference` on purpose — between `reference.width` and `canvas.width` the composition does not scale at all (the height arm pins the factor at 1.0), it simply gets more room.

width.description: The drawn frame width in px. Emitted as the `fluid-cap-*` grow-only max-width ceiling for the page frame.

gutter.description: The drawn page gutter in px, for documentation/example use (e.g. `fluid-px-<gutter>` at the page edge). Not baked into a custom property by itself.

engageAt.description: Min-width in px where the scale turns on, emitted as `@media (width >= <engageAt>px)`. Below it every fluid unit is a flat 1px, so every value under this breakpoint is untouched. Must be <= reference.width (the scale cannot engage past its own reference).

heightAxis.description: true (default): `--fluid` takes min(width arm, height arm) via svh, giving the 'never taller than one screen' guarantee. false: drops the height arm entirely — `--fluid` is width-only (`max(floor, 100vw / reference.width)`) — for sites with no one-screen/pinned sections, where an svh dependency buys nothing and only adds mobile-toolbar risk.

units.description: Per-unit tuning. `fluid` is the one measured unit; `display` and `copy` are damped percentages of it; `chrome` is a fourth, independently-floored role for site chrome (header/footer) that never shrinks on a short-but-wide window.

floor.description: Hard floor in px-equivalent (unitless, multiplied by 1px) below which `--fluid` stops shrinking. Chosen, not derived — pick the value at which the layout itself breaks (default 0.58, measured at a 522px-tall section: 0.58 * 900).

damping.description: Rate `--fluid-display` shrinks relative to `--fluid` below the reference, in (0,1]. Read 0.62 as 'display type shrinks at 62% of the rate the layout does'. The design point is exact for any damping because `d*1 + (1-d) = 1`.

oneOf.description: round2(damping * engageAt/reference.width + (1 - damping)) — the value the damped curve reaches exactly at engageAt, i.e. what the role hands over at the breakpoint where the flat-1px mobile layout takes over.

floor.description: Hard floor for `--fluid-display`. 'auto' derives it from `damping`; a number overrides it.

damping.description: Rate `--fluid-copy` shrinks relative to `--fluid` below the reference, in (0,1]. Kept separate from `display.damping` because the two roles cannot share one rate: measured, a single gentle rate blows headings to too many lines, a single steep rate makes body copy unreadable.

oneOf.description: round2(damping * engageAt/reference.width + (1 - damping)) at the defaults this is 0.90.

floor.description: Hard floor for `--fluid-copy`. 'auto' derives it from `damping`; a number overrides it.

enabled.description: Emit `--fluid-chrome`, a fourth role for site chrome (header menu, dropdowns, footer): width-fit, height-floored (`min(100vw/W, max(1px, 100svh/H))`) so it never shrinks when height binds on a short-but-wide window but still fits when width binds. Spent explicitly at call sites (`calc(N * var(--fluid-chrome))`); there is no parallel utility family.

ceiling.description: null (default): uncapped growth — past the reference the whole composition scales as one, with no fixed frame marooned in empty space. A number N wraps `--fluid` (and therefore the type units, which read through it) in `min(Npx, ...)`, capping growth at N drawn pixels-equivalent. It also wraps `--fluid-chrome` directly in its own `min(Npx, ...)` — chrome does not read `var(--fluid)`, so without this it keeps growing past N on exactly the large displays the ceiling exists for, while the floor (`units.fluid.floor`) still does not apply to chrome.
